commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: install btrfs-progs =="
sudo -n apk add --no-cache btrfs-progs >/tmp/apk-install.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/apk-install.log; exit 1; }
which mkfs.btrfs btrfs

echo "== STEP 2: create backing image =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/snapshots
sudo -n truncate -s 2G /var/lib/snapshots/srv-data.img
ls -la /var/lib/snapshots/srv-data.img

echo "== STEP 3: attach loop device and format btrfs =="
LOOPDEV=$(sudo -n losetup -f --show /var/lib/snapshots/srv-data.img)
echo "loop device: $LOOPDEV"
sudo -n mkfs.btrfs -f -L srvdata "$LOOPDEV" >/tmp/mkfs.log 2>&1
tail -5 /tmp/mkfs.log

echo "== STEP 4: mount top-level subvol for management =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /mnt/btrfsroot
sudo -n mount "$LOOPDEV" /mnt/btrfsroot
sudo -n btrfs subvolume create /mnt/btrfsroot/data

echo "== STEP 5: mount data subvolume at /srv/data =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data
sudo -n mount -o subvol=data "$LOOPDEV" /srv/data
mount | grep -E 'btrfsroot|srv/data'

echo "== STEP 6: persist across reboot via fstab (uses image path + loop option, not the transient loop device node) =="
IMG=/var/lib/snapshots/srv-data.img
grep -q "$IMG" /etc/fstab 2>/dev/null && sudo -n sed -i "\|$IMG|d" /etc/fstab || true
{
  echo "$IMG /mnt/btrfsroot btrfs loop,subvolid=5,nofail 0 0"
  echo "$IMG /srv/data btrfs loop,subvol=data,nofail 0 0"
} | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
cat /etc/fstab | grep srv-data.img

echo "== STEP 7: populate application data (baseline) =="
sudo -n sh -c 'cat > /srv/data/app.conf <<EOF
service=widget-api
version=1.0.0
env=production
EOF'
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "id,name,balance" > /srv/data/accounts.csv'
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "1,alice,1000" >> /srv/data/accounts.csv'
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "2,bob,2500" >> /srv/data/accounts.csv'
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data/logs
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "startup ok" > /srv/data/logs/app.log'
find /srv/data -type f | sort
echo "-- baseline checksum --"
sudo -n sh -c 'find /srv/data -type f -exec sha256sum {} \;' | sort -k2 | tee /tmp/baseline-checksum.txt

echo "== STEP 8: take read-only snapshot (baseline) =="
sudo -n btrfs subvolume snapshot -r /mnt/btrfsroot/data /mnt/btrfsroot/snap-baseline
sudo -n btrfs subvolume list /mnt/btrfsroot

echo "== STEP 9: modify /srv/data after snapshot =="
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "env=staging" >> /srv/data/app.conf'
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "3,mallory,999999" >> /srv/data/accounts.csv'
sudo -n rm -f /srv/data/logs/app.log
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "unauthorized change" > /srv/data/logs/tampered.log'
find /srv/data -type f | sort
echo "-- post-modification checksum --"
sudo -n sh -c 'find /srv/data -type f -exec sha256sum {} \;' | sort -k2 | tee /tmp/modified-checksum.txt

echo "== diff (expect differences) =="
diff /tmp/baseline-checksum.txt /tmp/modified-checksum.txt && echo "NO DIFF (unexpected)" || echo "DIFF CONFIRMED (expected)"
